implemented: A private genuine detached input separately owns the complete incoming portable archive, original/current/pending/live cuts, whole upload data and provider-only pixels after caller disposal. A distinct plan/head/intent/journal schema keeps older formats and public root exports closed.

The actual writable native source publishes verified input LIVE once through durable prepare/native-save/acknowledge under its same two native writer leases. Earlier imported cuts remain literal incoming provenance, not new bootstrap publications.

Every current/pending cut is replayed through actual temporary readonly Rust owners and must chronologically continue input LIVE and its preceding retained cut in both native histories, with unique ordered version prefixes. Matching hashes or final trees do not prove that continuity.

Cold reopen reconciles only exact retained pending/current cuts with the actual native store. Missing acknowledged input/source data refuses; a saved readiness bit never creates an empty editor or reconstructs a missing owner.

Policy and factories are snapshotted before callbacks. Genuine opening/source reservations reject authority reentry, storage-context replacement cannot redirect cleanup, and fresh authorized read custody survives ended write grants/signals.

Actual request-success cancellation rolls back active journal/native transactions while exact readable memory survives. Source close waits for held read scopes, final callback mutations refuse stale captures and failed cleanup retries the same actual owners.
